script.name: Backup Config Files
script.code:
Write-Host $(Get-ExecutionPolicy -Verbose)
Import-Module Microsoft.PowerShell.Archive -Verbose
# & "C:\Windows\System32\WindowsPowerShell\v1.0\Modules\Microsoft.PowerShell.Archive\Microsoft.PowerShell.Archive.psm1"

# Define the source folder and backup directory
$sourceFolder = Join-Path $ThisService.RootDirectory "garrysmod\cfg"
$backupDirectory = Join-Path $ThisService.RootDirectory "Backups"

# Ensure the backup directory exists
if (!(Test-Path $backupDirectory)) {
    New-Item -ItemType Directory -Path $backupDirectory | Out-Null
}

# Generate the timestamped zip file name
$timestamp = (Get-Date).ToString("yyyyMMdd-HHmmss")
$backupFileName = "$timestamp.zip"
$backupFilePath = Join-Path $backupDirectory $backupFileName

Write-Host "Creating backup: $backupFileName"

# Create the zip archive
try {
    Compress-Archive -Path $sourceFolder -DestinationPath $backupFilePath -Force -Verbose
    Write-Host "Backup created successfully: $backupFileName"
} catch {
    Write-Host "Error creating backup: $_" -ForegroundColor Red
}
